changelog.2: added generated_at (last column); meeting JSON and latest.json gain generated_at and source_fetched_at

name: hkjc_trip_notes
description: One row per reviewer trip note for an HKJC meeting, enriched with official HKJC results, stewards' report and sectional data. Blank (CSV) / null (JSON) always means unknown or not applicable, never zero or false.

files.YYYY-MM-DD_VENUE.csv: one meeting, columns in the order below
files.YYYY-MM-DD_VENUE.json: {schema_version, meeting:{date,venue,venue_name,course,going,races_reviewed,limitations,sources}, rows:[...]} with typed values (booleans, numbers, flags as array, null = unknown)
files.all_trip_notes.csv: all meetings concatenated, deduplicated on date+venue+race+horse
files.latest.json: pointer to the most recent meeting files

meeting_block.source_fetched_at: latest successful (HTTP 200) fetch time of this meeting's DisplaySectionalTime pages, ISO 8601 +08:00, from raw/fetch_log.tsv; null if none
meeting_block.limitations: list of strings (from workdir limitations.json/.txt plus automatic notes for withdrawn horses, out-of-vocabulary flags and sectional gaps)
meeting_block.sources: official URLs and legacy file path

latest_json.generated_at: build time of the latest meeting

columns.name: schema_version
columns.meaning: Schema version of this row (2 = v1 columns + generated_at).

columns.name: date
columns.meaning: Meeting date (Hong Kong local).

columns.name: venue
columns.meaning: ST = Sha Tin, HV = Happy Valley.

columns.name: race
columns.meaning: Race number on the card.

columns.name: race_index
columns.meaning: HKJC season race index (e.g. 178) from LocalResults.

columns.name: class
columns.meaning: Official race class string, e.g. 'Class 3', 'Group Three'.

columns.name: distance_m
columns.meaning: Race distance in metres.

columns.name: course
columns.meaning: Track/course from official results, normalised: 'Turf B', 'Turf C+3', 'All Weather Track'.

columns.name: going
columns.meaning: Official going for that track on the day, uppercase (e.g. GOOD).

columns.name: horse
columns.meaning: Official horse name exactly as in HKJC results (uppercase). Join key with horse_code.

columns.name: horse_code
columns.meaning: HKJC brand code, e.g. L165. Most reliable join key.

columns.name: draw
columns.meaning: Barrier draw. Blank for withdrawn horses.

columns.name: jockey
columns.meaning: Jockey as printed on official results (may include apprentice claim, e.g. '(-2)').

columns.name: finish
columns.meaning: Official placing as a string; keeps dead heats ('7 DH'). Blank = withdrawn/no placing.

columns.name: win_odds
columns.meaning: Official final win odds (decimal dividend per $1, HKJC style). Blank if withdrawn.

columns.name: flags
columns.meaning: Trip-note flags from the reviewer, semicolon-separated legacy vocabulary. Blank = no flags.

legacy_exceptions.wide: Appears once in legacy 2026-11-08 data (R7 MONARCH COUNTY); kept verbatim. Means raced wide; cover status not encoded in the flag.

flag_meanings.slow_away: slow/awkward start or lost ground at the start
flag_meanings.more_in_hand: won/ran with more in hand than margin
flag_meanings.faded_after_leading: led or raced prominently then weakened
flag_meanings.vet_blocked: official vet issue / clearance required before racing again
flag_meanings.possible_issue: something looked wrong, not officially confirmed

columns.name: traffic
columns.meaning: True if flags contain any of blocked, checked, hampered, bumped, crowded. False = none of those flagged by the review (not proof of a clean trip).

columns.name: wide_no_cover
columns.meaning: True if flags contain wide_no_cover. False = not flagged. Blank = unknown (legacy 'wide' flag without cover info).

columns.name: slow_away
columns.meaning: True if flags contain slow_away. False = not flagged.

columns.name: stewards_excuse
columns.meaning: Verbatim official stewards' racing-incident text for this horse (RaceReportFull). Blank if the report said 'No report.' or only 'Sent for sampling post-race.' When present it is the full verbatim text, which may include the sampling sentence.

columns.name: sampled
columns.meaning: True if the stewards' text includes 'Sent for sampling post-race' (routine drug test). Blank if no stewards entry exists. NOTE: this column is inserted directly after stewards_excuse.

columns.name: pace_role
columns.meaning: Derived ONLY from the first official running position (LocalResults 'Running Position', first call) and field size N (runners with positions): 1 = led; 2-3 = on_pace; 4..ceil(2N/3) = midfield; > ceil(2N/3) = back. Blank if no official positions (e.g. withdrawn).

columns.name: pace_note
columns.meaning: Official running positions string plus any pace-related review flags (led_throughout, soft_lead, faded_after_leading, keen, strong_closer). No free-text inference.

columns.name: vet_finding
columns.meaning: Verbatim official sentences from the stewards' text about veterinary findings (inspection results, blood in trachea, lameness, heart rhythm, vet checks pre-race, vet withdrawals). Official text only; blank if none.

columns.name: clearance_required
columns.meaning: Verbatim official sentence(s) beginning 'Before being allowed to race again...' (official veterinary examination, stalls test, barrier trial). Blank if none.

columns.name: horse_last_400m_sec
columns.meaning: This horse's official final sectional (last 400m) in seconds, from HKJC DisplaySectionalTime (https://racing.hkjc.com/racing/information/English/Racing/DisplaySectionalTime.aspx?RaceDate=DD/MM/YYYY&RaceNo=N, which redirects to racing.hkjc.com/en-us/local/information/displaysectionaltime). Raw HTML kept under raw/. Blank if unavailable (e.g. withdrawn).

columns.name: race_last_400m_sec
columns.meaning: Race's official final sectional (leader's last 400m split) in seconds, from LocalResults 'Sectional Time' row. Cross-checked against the DisplaySectionalTime header.

columns.name: note
columns.meaning: Reviewer's trip note, copied verbatim from the legacy trip_notes.csv.

columns.name: source
columns.meaning: Evidence behind the flags/note: replay only, stewards only, or both.

columns.name: results_url
columns.meaning: Official LocalResults URL for the race.

columns.name: stewards_url
columns.meaning: Official RaceReportFull URL for the meeting.

columns.name: replay_url
columns.meaning: Official HKJC replay-full video URL for the race (only for rows whose source includes replay).

columns.name: verification
columns.meaning: Per-row provenance and limitations (where the sectional came from, replay angle limits, replay-only rows, out-of-vocabulary flags, gaps).

columns.name: generated_at
columns.meaning: Build time of the file this row was written in (same for every row of one build). Added in schema_version 2.
